name: fingerprint-program-v1

hypotheses.H1_family: the frozen signature battery attributes held-out models to their family above chance, leave-one-family-member-out, family as unit
hypotheses.H2_corpus: controlled pairs differing only in corpus/post-training separate beyond the worst within-family range on >=1 battery feature: gpt-neo-125M vs gpt2 (replication, seeds); gpt2 vs distilgpt2; one base-vs-instruct sibling pair
hypotheses.H3_dynamics: CA-derived features add attribution/separation power over the direct two-token-conditional baseline computed on the same models
hypotheses.H4_api: the battery computed through a raw completion API (temperature-controlled, single-token calls) reproduces the local signature within seed spread

battery: direct p(.|x1,x2) stats: argmax fixed-point count, mean top-1, entropy (the baseline)
frozen.attribution_protocol: nearest family centroid, all-families candidate set, leave-one-out; report counts vs chance
frozen.pair_protocol: gap over worst within-family range, per feature, 4 seeds per side

kill_conditions.K1_deflation: direct-conditional baseline matches or exceeds CA features on H1 AND H2 -> the CA machinery exits; capability reframes as conditional-statistics fingerprinting
kill_conditions.K2_pairs: neither the neo/gpt2 replication nor any of {distilgpt2, instruct-sibling} pair separates beyond worst within-family range -> corpus/post-training inference dies; F64 stays a control
kill_conditions.K3_api: chat-template wrapping destroys the signature AND no raw completion endpoint reproduces it -> capability scoped to open-weight serving only

note: Gate 0 (reanalysis of existing screen data) precedes this block and is exploratory; Gates 1-3 are governed by it. Deduped-Pythia pair is registered as a discovery probe, not a requirement.
